notes:
v4.6.8 — Alpaca Paper/Live trading toggle in header

✨ NEW
• iPhone-style PAPER/LIVE pill button next to BAPTOU header. Click toggles between Alpaca paper trading (simulated, default) and live trading (real money). Switching to LIVE requires explicit confirmation in a warning dialog.
• LIVE mode pill renders in red (`◉ LIVE`) for unmissable visual feedback; PAPER renders as a muted (`○ paper`) pill.
• Mode propagates end-to-end: stored in settings.json → exported as APEX_ALPACA_MODE to every bot subprocess (local AND cloud via the encrypted credentials blob) → bot_framework + every built-in bot (longbot, shortbot, daybot) constructs TradingClient with the correct paper=… flag.
• Universe doesn't need to rerun when switching modes — universe files are mode-agnostic.

Includes v4.6.7's QLabel/QPushButton crash hotfix + the universe-generator save-path fix (now lands in Universe tab, not More Bots) + the Make Bot strategy-viability guardrails.
